Santa Clara County

Santa Clara County is Silicon Valley, with San Jose the state's third-largest city and the headquarters campuses of Apple, Google and Nvidia across Cupertino, Mountain View and Santa Clara. Development is transit-oriented and vertical — Diridon Station, North San Jose, the BART extension — with jobs-housing imbalance, the Coyote Valley greenbelt purchase, and Santa Clara Valley Habitat Plan fees governing what moves.
Source: U.S. Census Bureau · Data verified: November 8, 2026
